On Thu, Apr 21, 2022 at 4:47 PM Maany Peyvan <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Michelle!
Not sure if you remember but we met a couple times back when I was at the Obama
Foundation to organize Twitter conversations during Black History Month and
International Women's Day.
I work at USAID now along with all of the amazing people cc'ed, supporting Administrator
Samantha Power, and we've lined up a Twitter Spaces conversation for her and some
Ukrainian journalists on World Press Freedom Day, on May 3.
I'm wondering if we could connect with you and see if this is something you all would be
interested in helping us promote, or discuss other collaborations and cool partnerships w
could consider. I feel like there's plenty of overlap in terms of what we could do, so let u
Thanks,
-Maany
